description: This file defines a custom SwiftUI ViewModifier that changes the mouse cursor to a pointing hand when hovering over a view and reverts it when the hover ends. It provides an extension on View to easily apply this cursor effect.

classes.name: PointingHandCursorModifier
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that manages changing the cursor to a pointing hand when the view is hovered.

methods.name: pointingHandCursor()
methods.description: A View extension method that applies the PointingHandCursorModifier to the view.
